draft.subject: Re: Cancellation timing
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Following up on your note about cancellation timing: a cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately. Your ticket is still open on our side, so anything else you need clarified there, I'll handle it.

In the meantime, you've already got a first project going in Wrenfield and an invite out to a teammate. If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week to walk through whatever's getting in the way before you decide.

Either way, thanks for giving Wrenfield a look.

Best,
Chidi
